description: Connect Claude to Lawmatics: matters, contacts, pipelines, tasks, forms, custom fields, invoices.
name: io.github.oktopeak/lawmatics-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Lawmatics OAuth access token (never expires). Obtain once with `npx @oktopeak/lawmatics-mcp auth`.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable all write tools (create/update/tag/submit). Read-only mode for cautious firms.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_READ_ONLY

environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable experimental tools (set-matter-custom-fields) whose API request shape is not fully documented by Lawmatics.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_EXPERIMENTAL_TOOLS

environmentVariables.description: Client-side request throttle per minute (default: 50, the conservative documented per-firm limit; newer docs say 150).
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN

environmentVariables.description: Set to '0' to disable the local JSONL audit log (default path: ~/.lawmatics-mcp/audit.log).
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_AUDIT_LOG

environmentVariables.description: Override the audit log file location (default: ~/.lawmatics-mcp/audit.log). The log contains tool arguments, which can include client data.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_AUDIT_LOG_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Only needed for the one-time `auth` command: your Lawmatics developer app client ID.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Only needed for the one-time `auth` command: your Lawmatics developer app client secret.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Local port for the one-time OAuth callback (default: 5678). Must match the app's Callback URL.
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_REDIRECT_PORT

environmentVariables.description: Override the Lawmatics API base URL (default: https://api.lawmatics.com/v1).
environmentVariables.name: LAWMATICS_API_BASE
